en.headline: Customs seizes 535kg cannabis worth HK$125m in largest sea haul
en.dek: Three men were arrested in Mong Kok after officers found the drugs hidden in insulated boxes from a Thailand-bound container following a 16-day surveillance operation.
body: Hong Kong Customs has seized 535 kilograms of suspected cannabis flowers with an estimated market value of HK$125 million in what it described as the largest sea-route cannabis trafficking case on record.

Officers inspected a container arriving from Thailand that was declared to carry insulated boxes. Of 1,342 boxes, 364 were found heavier than normal and contained vacuum-packed cannabis flowers. Tracking devices had been placed inside some of the boxes, Customs said.

After 16 days of surveillance, officers arrested three men aged 21 to 47 in a Mong Kok tenement building when they collected the goods. One Vietnamese man holding a recognizance form was charged with attempting to traffic in a dangerous drug and is due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Monday. The other two were released on bail pending further inquiries.
Customs said cannabis seizures have been rising, with more than 3,500 kilograms recorded so far this year including the latest haul.

zh.headline: 海關破歷來最大宗海路大麻花案 檢535公斤值1.25億拘三人
zh.dek: 貨櫃由泰國抵港，部分保溫箱藏有定位器；經16日監控後於旺角唐樓拘三男，其中越南籍男子將被起訴。
body: 香港海關破獲歷來最大宗海路販運大麻花案，檢獲535公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值1.25億港元，並拘捕三名男子。
關員檢查一艘由泰國抵港、報稱載有保溫箱的貨櫃，在1,342箱中發現364箱較重，內藏以膠袋及真空包裝的大麻花。部分箱子內更放有定位追蹤裝置。
海關經過16日深入跟蹤，於旺角一唐樓單位採取行動，當場拘捕三名年齡介乎21至47歲的男子，包括兩名本地男子及一名持「行街紙」的越南籍男子。越南籍男子被控企圖販運危險藥物，下周一於九龍城裁判法院提堂，其餘兩人獲准保釋候查。
海關表示，近年檢獲大麻數量上升，計入今次案件，今年至今已逾3,500公斤。
